name: agentos-controller
title: AgentOS Controller
description: Observe AgentOS agents, sessions, projects, recent activity, pending approvals and health from Orbit. Safe and observational only: mock data by default, with optional local-JSON and HTTP read-only adapters. No shell, no task dispatch, no destructive actions.
author: orbit

preferences.name: source
preferences.title: Data source
preferences.description: Where to read AgentOS state from. 'mock' uses bundled sample data (default, fully offline). 'json' reads a local JSON file. 'http' fetches a read-only AgentOS endpoint.

preferences.name: jsonPath
preferences.title: Local JSON file path
preferences.description: Absolute path to a JSON file with { agents, sessions, projects, activity, approvals }. Used only when source = json.

preferences.name: httpBaseUrl
preferences.title: AgentOS base URL
preferences.description: Base URL of a read-only AgentOS state endpoint (http/https only), e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8787. Used only when source = http.

preferences.name: dashboardUrl
preferences.title: Dashboard URL
preferences.description: URL opened by the 'Open AgentOS Dashboard' action (http/https only).

preferences.name: workspaceUrlTemplate
preferences.title: Agent workspace URL template
preferences.description: URL template for opening an agent workspace; {agent} is replaced with the agent name (http/https only). Example: http://127.0.0.1:8787/agents/{agent}

commands.name: list-agents
commands.title: AgentOS Agents
commands.description: List agents with status, current task, last activity, project and health

commands.name: list-projects
commands.title: AgentOS Projects
commands.description: List projects known to AgentOS (open folder or copy path)

commands.name: recent-activity
commands.title: AgentOS Recent Activity
commands.description: Show recent AgentOS activity across agents and projects

commands.name: pending-approvals
commands.title: AgentOS Pending Approvals
commands.description: Show actions awaiting human approval (observational; approve elsewhere)

commands.name: agent-health
commands.title: AgentOS Agent Health
commands.description: Show current health of each agent
